test.description: Issue #4582, from feedback #4561 session 1: the main thread transcribed image ARKs itself and listed them under 'Sources consulted' as bare `ark:/61903/3:1:…` values, though each image_transcribe had returned a full viewerUrl. Empty folder; one named image ARK, given bare. The router reads it itself (one named image, no projectPath) and must name it only as a link to the returned viewerUrl. The page text is live from the feedback bundle.

judge_context: The folder is empty and there is no project. The message names ONE image ARK and asks for its transcription: the router reads it itself with image_transcribe and no projectPath. Spawning init-project, tree-survey or search-images is wrong here.

Whether the reply names the page only as a link is asserted deterministically by test_reply_links_named_sources (tag links-sources): a bare `ark:/61903/…`, a bare image id or a URL without https:// fails it. Do not re-grade linking yourself.

The page gives Philip Eastman jun. and Elizabeth Hodges's marriage and three daughters, Mary, Pheba and Esther; every date is illegible. PASS requires those three named, the dates reported as illegible rather than supplied, and no other child attributed to Philip.
A separate, earlier Philip Eastman is not on this page. Calling any man on it Philip's father is a fault.
